about:
Loyal Stricklin was founded in April 2014 in Nashville, Tennessee, by Michael Stricklin while he was completing graduate studies in design and construction at Auburn University. What began as a creative outlet and a way to earn extra money during school became a full-time operation by August of that same year. The company remains owned and operated by Stricklin, who works on the production floor daily alongside a small team of craftsmen and women.

The brand produces high-end outerwear, pants, and leather goods, including denim jeans, waxed canvas jackets, and leather accessories. All cutting, sewing, and assembly labor is performed in the United States, with the majority of goods made to order in the company's Nashville workshop. Additional production capacity comes from a network of partner sewing shops in California and Texas. Materials are sourced from Japanese and Italian mills as well as American suppliers such as Horween Leather.

Loyal Stricklin sells directly to consumers seeking durable, American-made workwear and leather goods, serving denim enthusiasts and customers who value garments that improve with age. The company also offers made-to-order clothing with a typical lead time of four to six weeks.

Stricklin emphasizes uncompromising material quality and domestic manufacturing as the foundation of the brand. The company states that its products are built to endure real use, developing character over time, and points to over 11 years in business as evidence of its commitment to lasting craftsmanship.
